author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Strike Force Heroes

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friends. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host picks the mode and settings with the mouse. Friends get the host's next saved classes, or the mission's class.

keys.does: Move; W, Up or Space jumps; S crouches.
Aim and fire with your own mouse.
Swap gun; E or Ctrl fires a killstreak.

tips: Friends are on the host's team in team modes and the campaign; experience goes to the host's class.
A friend who leaves stays down, and the match goes on.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
New: not yet played by people on two PCs or over the internet. Tell us how it runs.

description: Strike Force Heroes (Sky9 Games, 2012): up to 4 friends fight next to the bots in Quick Match, the campaign and challenges, each with their own soldier, camera and crosshair.
